name: JobFinder AI - Automated Job Search and ATS CV Generator

parameters.content:
## 🚀 JobFinder AI — Self-Hosted n8n Job Hunter (100% Free Stack)
### Quick Setup via n8n Credentials Tab:
1. Open n8n **Credentials** (left sidebar) and create 2 free credentials:
   - **Google Gemini(PaLM) Api**: Paste your free Google AI Studio key (`https://aistudio.google.com/apikey`), keep default host `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`
   - **Discord Webhook**: Paste your Discord channel Webhook URL
2. Select those credentials in the **Gemini** and **Discord** nodes (marked in orange until linked).
3. Check candidate info, languages, and `gotenberg_url` (`http://gotenberg:3000`) in **`Initialize Profile and Settings`**, then click **Test workflow**.
4. **Job Categories**: Tier 1 AI & n8n Automation, Enterprise/MES & API Integration; Tier 2 Observability/Linux/DevOps & Technical Solutions.
5. **Scoring & Pings**: `70+` with valid/unspecified location generates **EN + Hungarian ATS PDF CVs**, saves to `/home/node/.n8n`, and pings `@everyone` in Discord. `50-69` sends a quiet 'Maybe' alert (no `@everyone`). Explicit office violations are dropped (`SKIPPED`).

## 🔎 Stage 1: Multi-Source Scraping & Pre-Filter
- **LinkedIn Guest API**: Searches configured target locations and regional radius queries across non-SWE integration/automation/DevOps tracks.
- **NoFluffJobs JSON API**: Pulls configured city and English Remote roles.
- **Zero-Cost Deduplication**: Checks `/home/node/.n8n/seen_jobs.json` + workflow static data and filters out excluded industries, SWE developer titles, junior, and unrelated stack titles before calling Gemini.

## 🧠 Stage 2: 4-Part Rubric & Strict Location Gate
- Processes 1 new job at a time with a **4s Wait** node to stay under free-tier 15 RPM limits.
- Uses `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` + deterministic JS enforcement: **Role 35 + Tech 30 + AI-Proof Security 20 + Location/Comp 15**.
- Drops explicit office/location failures (`SKIPPED`), warns when office/HO days are unspecified (`-5` pts), and pings `@everyone` only when CVs are generated.

## 📄 Stage 3: Configurable ATS CV & Cover Letter PDF Pipeline
- Uses `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (free tier) to write tailored **English + Hungarian** CVs (and Cover Letters when requested).
- Renders clean single-column ATS HTML to convert to PDF via **Gotenberg** (`http://gotenberg:3000`) to save to `/home/node/.n8n/JobFinder_[Date]_[Filename]` and upload PDFs to **Discord**.
